description: A transmission whose data to the peer fits one block at its MAX-SPEED rung is a latency transmission and goes at the peer's LOW-SPEED rung.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 the burst's one block holds PADDING D_PDUs (type 14) to 0.0.1.2, EOT 10, each carrying one EOW; the PADDING itself is ignored (C-0588). A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit records its sender Ed4 (interp C-1261). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; per rung the block bytes and ms given in the config (test data). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node makes no recommendation of its own (corpus-format.md 6.2); sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. The burst from 0.0.1.3 holds CAPABILITY, MAX-SPEED WN 6 Long (0x8A6) and LOW-SPEED WN 4 Short (0x964). The U_PDU is 'hello': its 35-byte type 7 fits one 256-byte block of the MAX-SPEED rung, so the transmission is for latency (open question 7, interp C-1285) and goes at the LOW-SPEED rung, WN 4 Short, on the ladder with exactly that interleaver (open question 5) and not above MAX-SPEED (C-0894). Fixture WN 4 Short: 128 bytes and 1200 ms a block (test data), so one block, 1950 ms, EOT and window ceil(1350 / 500) = 3; the type 7 carries SENDER-APPROACH (interp C-1286), then 8 PADDING with CAPABILITY fill the block (C-1154).
